content.reason: Accepted for exactly what it asserts. The two declared requirements are satisfied by independent records: the kernel gate passes on a CI attestation read at commit a8c2872a, and all four defining notions correspond to Formal Conjectures' Erdos321.R at pages commit 59f30aa3, each by a stated bridge. The third check is retained as complementary and is inconclusive, not passing: erdos_321 and its three asymptotic variants all carry answer(sorry) at this commit, so no fixed formal statement exists for this development to match or fail to match. That is why the Claim says candidate answer rather than proof. Erdos problem 321 remains open and this authority takes no position on it. Read beside the Erdos 522 rejection in this same repository, the pair shows the two ways a scalar green check misreports: there the statement exists and is vacuous, here it does not exist at all.
